The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db`, `nvs-ir` and `nvs-config` gap directories are closed for this goal. The other three `nvs-ir` gaps are owned by milestones M10 and M12. The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main` and the loop never pushes (`tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`'s module doc). A person pushes. No session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps, across many crates. Smallest directories first: `nvs-server` and `website` (2 each), `vscode` (3), `nvs-cli` and `nvs-host` (4). Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6. That is expected.
